name: race_strip_both_clocks_with_stacked_waves
description: The race strip with both sides' waves stacked (0.8.0's own race clock joined with M8's stacked waves, design 5.7): racing the caretaker, whose Lamplighter calls wave 2 during wave 1 by its plan, I call wave 2 during my wave 1 too (D twice; my creeps held where they stand, so nothing gets through). The strip says 'Waves 1–2/12' for my road, and its second line starts with my own race clock, 'You 0:04 +60 s' after a life lost (a minute a life since M8), then the rival's line naming the waves on its road ('Rival · Waves 1–3 · 20 lives · 0:04' with seed 1: its plan calls waves 2 and 3 early) and its own clock; mine before the rival's on one line, the plate within the screen.

steps.assert: theirs.size() >= 2 and node('Hud').rival_line().begins_with('Rival · Waves %d–%d · ' % [theirs[0], theirs[theirs.size() - 1]]) and node('Hud').rival_line().ends_with(Game.race_clock(Game.sim.tick, Game.sim.race_penalty_t(1)))
steps.msg: the rival's line names the waves on its road, then its clock

steps.assert: Game.sim.race_penalty_t(0) == 3600 and node('Hud').race_clock_line() == 'You · %s +60 s' % Game.race_clock(Game.sim.tick) and node('MineClock').text == '%s +60 s' % Game.race_clock(Game.sim.tick)
steps.msg: my own clock leads it, a minute for the life lost

steps.assert: mine.end.x < rival.position.x and absf(mine.position.y - rival.position.y) < 2 and plate.position.x >= 0 and plate.end.x <= 1280
steps.msg: mine before the rival's, on one line, the plate on the screen
